findings.failure_path: All three awk selectors leave f unset if the opening heading is renamed or deleted. The gate therefore passes without examining the core.
findings.smallest_fix: Validate that exactly one opening and closing boundary exists in the correct order, and reject extraction errors or an empty region before interpreting grep results. Apply this to all three references and add a missing-start-heading negative fixture.
